meta.name: comparative-state-analysis
meta.description: Use when comparing competing states or explaining why weaker parties prevail. Analyzes material resources, leadership quality, and intangible factors like popular support, governance quality, moral legitimacy, and application of benevolence (仁义).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比分析国家或政治实体的综合实力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需评估国家间实力对比或战略态势。
copy.tagline_en: Compare comprehensive power of states or political entities.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to assess power dynamics between states or strategic situations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会比较两个国家的物质资源（领土、人口、财富等）和领导能力，还会评估民众支持、治理质量、道德合法性以及是否施行仁义，从而解释为何弱小一方可能获胜。
howto.when: 当用户请求比较两个国家，或解释为什么弱势方能在对抗中胜出时触发。

say.text: 为什么小国能打败大国？
say.note: Claude 会从物质和无形因素分析原因。

say.text: 比较明朝和清朝的国力差异
say.note: Claude 会综合评估双方资源与治理质量。

say.text: 仁义在战争中起多大作用？
say.note: Claude 会解释仁义作为无形因素的影响。

howto.what_en: Claude compares two states by analyzing material resources (territory, population, wealth) and leadership, then evaluates intangible factors like popular support, governance quality, moral legitimacy, and application of benevolence (renyi) to explain why a weaker party might prevail.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a comparison of two states or asks why a weaker party wins against a stronger one.

say_en.text: Why can a small state defeat a big one?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes material and intangible factors.

say_en.text: Compare Ming and Qing dynasties' strengths
say_en.note: Claude assesses both material and governance aspects.

say_en.text: How important is benevolence in war?
say_en.note: Claude explains benevolence as an intangible factor.
